newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kyongnam Bank closes US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Kyongnam Bank closes US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Kyongnam Bank's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit has been allotted, arranger Standard Chartered Investment Banking said.
The five-year issue has put and call options in year three. It was priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier manager is 50 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$7 million each, are KDB Asia, LTCB Asia, Merrill Lynch Far East and Standard Chartered Bank.
Co-arrangers with US$6 million each, are Nishi-Nippon Finance Hong Kong and Yokohama Asia.

Co-managers, with US$3 million each, are Baden- Wurttembergische Bank AG and Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong. Co-managers, with US$2 million each, are Bank of Taiwan Hong Kong and Taiwan Cooperative Bank, Offshore Banking.
